back: E-business: all business activities done electronically. E-commerce: buying and selling over the internet or other networks; one part of e-business.
B2C: business to consumer. B2B: business to business. C2C: consumer to consumer.
Mobile money, cards through a secure gateway, bank transfer and cash on delivery; confirm payments with the service and never ask for PINs.
Profit = revenue − (fixed costs + variable costs); revenue = price × units sold.
Break-even = fixed costs ÷ (price − variable cost per unit).
Closing cash = opening cash + cash in − cash out; it becomes the next month's opening cash.
A business can have a profit on paper but little cash if customers pay late or stock must be paid for first.
Benefits: wider market, lower costs, records. Risks: fraud, delivery problems, dependence on networks and power, data protection.
